description: Generate a short video from a prompt and/or a start image with one of StockCake's video models (list_models). Priced per second of output; needs a plan. Video usually takes longer than 45 s: expect a pending result and poll get_job. Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

aspect_ratio.description: Text-to-video only; a start image sets the ratio

context.description: In one sentence, what is the user trying to make or find?

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length; must be one of the model's durations

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

model.description: Video model id from list_models (default: MiniMax H3)

start_image.description: Animate from this image (stock id or your edited image id)

name: create_video
title: Create Video
